items.title: 52193_Jay McShann oral history interview
items.q: So I had to have a bigger band at the Century Room and when I went up to Omaha and got Some [(note)] of Nat Towles' men

ctx.x: That was at the Century Room and we started to work in the Century Room. So I had to have a bigger band at the Century Room and when I went up to Omaha and got Some
In fact, Mr. Bales gave me the money to do that, to go get these guys. But all other monies come right out of the band. A lot of people they think that Tomino didn't spend no money for that band.
